messages:
michael: Heads-up: noticed a regression in throughput after the kernel-selector change yesterday. A100 hosts started hitting a new max_tokens_per_batch ceiling and KV-fragmentation spiked. Observed a ~12% drop in tokens/s on mixed-card pools. Anyone else?
anya: saw that too. Logs show kernel-selector started preferring kernel-v2 for long sequences which increases per-token latency when KV fragments > 32MB. cc @cheng @sam
sam: profile dump from host-42 (A100/GPU0):
```
avg token latency: 3.8ms
p95 token latency: 8.9ms
KV frag: 41MB
kernel: kernel-v2
batch tokens: 1024
```
Seems like kernel-v2 + big batches == worse.
cheng: kernel-v2 has higher init cost but better steady-state. For A100 we should lower max_tokens_per_batch soft cap to avoid switching cost. Also weight queue prioritization to favor smaller batches when KV frag > 24MB.
michael: Proposal: per-GPU max_tokens + max_batch_size matrix and soft/hard caps. Quick config I want to try on staging:
```
"per_gpu_limits": {
  "A100": {"max_tokens_soft": 800, "max_tokens_hard": 1600, "max_batch_size": 64},
  "H100": {"max_tokens_soft": 1200, "max_tokens_hard": 2400, "max_batch_size": 128},
  "A10":  {"max_tokens_soft": 600, "max_tokens_hard": 1200, "max_batch_size": 48},
  "L4":   {"max_tokens_soft": 400, "max_tokens_hard": 800,  "max_batch_size": 32},
  "T4":   {"max_tokens_soft": 300, "max_tokens_hard": 600,  "max_batch_size": 24}
}
"kv_frag_threshold_mb": 24
"queue_policy": "weighted-by-kv-frag"
```
This keeps H100 aggressive, tames A100 to avoid kernel-v2 startup hits, and limits L4/T4 packing.
anya: looks reasonable. suggest we also add kernel preference override: prefer kernel-v1 when batch_tokens < soft_cap or kv_frag > threshold.
sam: what's our AB plan? I'd capture tokens/s, p50/p95 latency, KV miss rate, kernel-switch rate per minute.
cheng: I'll run the config on staging pool 'staging-mix-4' at 11:30 PT. Using commit cf1a2d2. Expect before/after metrics in ~20m.
perf-bot: perf summary (staging-mix-4) for last 30m -> before: tokens/s 18.7k, p95 9.2ms, kernel-switch-rate 4/min, KV frag avg 38MB. after (rolling apply): tokens/s 20.6k, p95 8.1ms, kernel-switch-rate 1/min, KV frag avg 22MB. link: https://perf.redwood/reports/1712349012
michael: Nice! Can we push soft caps to prod for A100 only and monitor for 2 hours? Rollback plan: revert per_gpu_limits for A100 if p95 increases > 5%.
anya: yep. I'll open a rollout PR and include canary on 5% of A100 hosts.
sam: Add alert: kernel-switch-rate spike > 10/min or KV frag > 40MB.
cheng: I'll watch. ping me if anything odd. /me will tail logs.
michael: :thumbsup: thanks team. We'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything regresses.
